notes.title: Demo 2.1 Released!
notes.content:
Demo 2.1 of Back To The Dark is now available!

The main changes are an update to the lighting, item highlight outlines, character shadows, and some more performance tweaks.

[list]
[*] Updated lighting.
[*] Added shadows to characters.
[*] Highlighting of interactable items.
[*] Added Attack Speed statistic.
[*] Added new treasures.
[*] Performance improvements.
[*] Updated logo.
[/list]
Check out the updated visuals in the latest trailer:

[previewyoutube=eMKg98oLoeY;full][/previewyoutube]
There's also a comparison screenshot of Demos 1 vs 2 vs 2.1 from a previous DevLog:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885341/c6f4e4f5b20ab0226beb15d6bd1c471ac162b59f.png[/img]

Hope you like it all! Please feel free to leave comments etc etc...

notes.title: Demo 2 Now Available!
notes.content:
Back To The Dark: Demo 2 is now available for download!

Changes since Demo 1 include:
[list]
[*] [b]New mobs![/b] 🕷
[*] [b]New dungeon layouts![/b]
[*] [b]New rooms![/b]
[*] [b]New textures![/b]
[*] [b]New lighting![/b]
[*] [b]Shadows! Everywhere![/b]
[*] [b]More audio fx![/b]
[*] [b]Tutorial Dungeon![/b]
[*] [b]Some quests in "Trophies & Rewards"[/b]
[*] [b]Armour![/b]
[*] Necklaces.
[*] New mob behaviours.
[*] Vertical doors!
[*] Updated hit detection.
[*] Updated UI rendering.
[*] Redesigned item detail panel.
[*] Improved support for higher resolutions/aspect ratios.
[*] Improved performance for low end systems.
[/list]
Save games from Demo 1 are supported, however the amount of new content since Demo 1 is not very big, so previous players might find this release a little underwhelming.

A future "Demo 3" will include more content in a few months, including quests, unlockables, spells, stats, bosses...

Any feedback, problems, bugs, performance issues, or suggestions are welcomed in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2372560/discussions/]community discussions board[/url].

[previewyoutube=bG5R8dUTC9A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo 2: Devlog 2
notes.content:
I had hoped to have the new demo available by now but unfortunately due to a.n.other distractions I've not been able to make the progress that I was looking for. 

However I am still, gradually, working on it and hoping to make it available in the next few weeks. 

The current development focus is on performance optimizations, as the frame time has doubled over the original demo, and so I'm trying to claw back as much performance as possible to ensure a smooth framerate on as wide a variety of hardware as possible.

Here's an updated list of features in the upcoming demo:
[list]
[*] [b]New mobs![/b]
[*] [b]New dungeon layouts![/b]
[*] [b]New rooms![/b]
[*] [b]New textures![/b]
[*] [b]More audio fx![/b]
[*] Shadows! Everywhere!
[*] Armour.
[*] Necklaces.
[*] New Enemy behaviours.
[*] Redesigned item detail panel.
[*] Vertical doors!
[*] Updated hit detection.
[*] Plus bug fixes and other smaller tweaks.
[/list]
As well as bug fixes etc.

notes.title: Small Demo Update - Korean Language Added
notes.content:
Back To The Dark has been updated with support for Korean language!

If the game doesn't automatically use your language you can set it by either: 
[list]
[*] Right-click the game in your "Steam" library, select Properties, then Language. 
[*] Otherwise you can also change it in game, by going to "Settings" -> "Game Options" -> and change "Language".
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Achievements Update
notes.content:
The Back To The Dark demo is now updated with a collection of steam achievements to aim for whilst dungeon delving, gold ingots to consolidate treasure, mobs with increased difficulty in deeper levels, a little more tweaking of item drop rarity, and a couple of crash/bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Added 12 Steam Achievements.
[*]Added gold ingots to shop.
[*]Increased enemy difficulty in deeper dungeon levels.
[*]Increased drop rarity in deeper dungeon levels.
[*]Added some statistics tracking e.g. number of escapes, deepest dungeon level reached.
[*]Fixed player hp not retained through red portals.
[*]Fixed dropped items appearing on top of the player.
[*]Fixed crash when "dropping" items in the tavern.
[*]Fixed game not pausing when opening steam overlay.
[/list]

notes.title: Back To The Dark Playable Demo Available (Update)
notes.content:
[b]Update: Demo extended until the end of April.[/b]

Playable demo of Back To The Dark now available!

The demo includes full controller support, although mouse + keyboard is recommended.

Back To The Dark is a dungeon delving demake with extraction-looter melee-combat. 

Can you survive the encroaching dark long enough to extract through a blue escape portal? Or will you be forced to delve deeper in the darkness through a red portal? Oh and don't forget to loot some treasure.

Help available from the main and "Escape" or "Start Button" menu.

[h2]Controls[/h2]

[h3]Mouse + Keyboard[/h3]
[b]Aim :[/b] Mouse 
[b]Attack/Use Item :[/b] Left Mouse
[b]Movement: [/b]WASD Keys
[b]Walk : [/b]Shift Key
[b]Interact :[/b] F Key
[b]Cycle Weapons/Items :[/b] 1/2/3/4 Keys
[b]Unequip Item :[/b] X Key
[b]Drop Item :[/b] Right Mouse
[b]Inventory :[/b] Tab Key 
[b]Menu :[/b] Escape Key
[b]Menu Navigation :[/b] Mouse + Left Mouse


[h3]Gamepad[/h3]
[b]Aim :[/b] Right Stick
[b]Attack/Use Item :[/b] Right Trigger
[b]Movement :[/b] Left Stick
[b]Walk :[/b] Left Trigger
[b]Interact :[/b] B Button
[b]Cycle Weapons/Items :[/b] Left/Right Shoulder Buttons
[b]Drop Item :[/b] X Button
[b]Inventory :[/b] Y Button
[b]Menu :[/b] Start Button
[b]Menu Navigation :[/b] Left Stick + A Button
